name: Squire

abilities.name: Stun
abilities.description: This creature's Stun ability gives it a chance of stunning enemies when it attacks in melee combat. Stunned enemies cannot take any action or retaliate for one turn.

summary:
The squire is a level-one creature of the Haven in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Squires use flails that have a chance of stunning an opponent for one turn. The chance of stunning depends on the damage done and the health of the target.

name: Crossbowman

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Long Range
abilities.description: Long Range allows this creature to ignore all ranged attack damage penalties for distance.

summary:
The crossbowman is a level-one creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The crossbowman's powerful weapon does full damage at any range.

name: Pikeman

abilities.name: Long Weapon
abilities.description: Long Weapon allows this creature to attack enemies that are at a short distance out of reach of normal melee attacks.

abilities.name: Negate First Strike
abilities.description: Negate First Strike allows this creature to counter First Strike abilities or spells.

summary:
The pikeman is a level-two creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Pikemen are masters of the pike, which gives their attack a great reach than most of their opponents. They are also immune to the First Strike ability.

name: Ballista

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Mechanical
abilities.description: Mechanical creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells or abilities that only work on living creatures.

abilities.name: Long Range
abilities.description: Long Range allows this creature to ignore all ranged attack damage penalties for distance.

abilities.name: No Obstacle Penalty
abilities.description: No Obstacle Penalty allows this creature to do full damage to targets behind castle walls and other obstacles.

summary:
The ballista is a level-two creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Ballistae are complicated mechanical units capable of firing a bolt over great distances. They can do full damage at any range, even behind obstacles and castle walls.

name: Crusader

abilities.name: Two Attacks
abilities.description: Two Attacks allows this creature to attack twice in melee combat. The second attack occurs after the enemy's retaliation.

abilities.name: Death Ward
abilities.description: Death Ward makes this creature 50% resistant to Death spells, and its Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Death-aligned opponents.

summary:
The crusader is a third-level creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. Monks have 50% magic resistance to Death spells.

Crusaders are fervent warriors, experts with the sword who can attack twice a turn. They are also resistant to Death Magic spells and take less damage from Death-aligned opponents.

name: Monk

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Death Ward
abilities.description: Death Ward makes this creature 50% resistant to Death spells, and its Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Death-aligned opponents.

summary:
The monk is a third-level creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. Monks have 50% magic resistance to Death spells.

Monks are resistant to Death Magic spells and take less damage from Death-aligned opponents.

name: Champion

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: First Strike allows this creature to strike an opponent in melee combat before it can retaliate.

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge allows this creature to do more damage after it charges for a long distance before attacking.

summary:
The champion is a fourth-level creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Champions can strike before their enemy can retaliate. And they do more damage when they charge over long distances to attack.

name: Angel

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Resurrection
abilities.description: Resurrection ability allows it to target friendly dead creatures and bring them back to life.

summary:
The angel is a fourth-level creature from the Haven town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Angels can resurrect friendly targets who have died in combat, but only those who were living before they were killed.

name: Peasant

abilities.name: Taxpayer
abilities.description: Taxpayer allows this creature to generate 1 gold per day for every individual unit the player controls.

summary:
The peasant is a first-level creature, connected to the Haven in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It is found at the hovel.

The peasant is the backbone of society. Each peasant raises 1 gold per day in taxes for their lords.

name: Catapult

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Mechanical
abilities.description: Mechanical creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells or abilities that only work on living creatures.

abilities.name: Siege Capable
abilities.description: This creature ignores all ranged attack damage penalties for distance and does full damage to targets behind castle walls and other obstacles.

abilities.name: Greek Fire
abilities.description: This creature's Area Attack allows its ranged attacks to strike all targets, friendly or hostile near the target, with deadly fire.

summary:
The catapult is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Haven in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Winds of War. It is found at the siege workshop.

The newest incarnation of the catapult is an engineering marvel, able to deliver its fiery gifts of warfare to even the most hidden of its foes.

name: Dwarf

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The Dwarf is 50% likely to resist offensive spells, and will only take half damage from Direct Damage spells.

summary:
The dwarf is a level-one creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Dwarves have a 50% chance of resisting any hostile spell, and take half damage from spell attacks.

name: Halfling

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Giantslayer
abilities.description: Giantslayer allows this creature to do extra damage to 4th level creatures.

summary:
The halfling is a level-one creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Halflings do extra damage against 4th level creatures.

name: Gold golem

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: The gold golem will resist 75% of the offensive spells targetting him. Likewise, he will only take 1/4 damage from direct damage spells cast his way.

abilities.name: Mechanical
abilities.description: Mechanical creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells or abilities that only work on living creatures.

summary:
The gold golem is a second-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Gold golems have a 75% chance of resisting any hostile spell, and take only 25% of damage from spell attacks.

name: Mage

abilities.name: Spellcaster
abilities.description: Mages can cast Blur, Magic Fist, Curse, Poison, and Raise skeletons. Each mage does 4.8 points of damage with Magic Fist, 2.4 points of Poison damage, and can raise 1.6 Skeletons. Each stack will start combat with 18 spell points.

summary:
The mage is a second-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The mage can cast the following spells: Blur, Curse, Magic Fist, Poison, and Raise Skeletons.

name: Naga

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: This creature's No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

summary:
The naga is a third-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The many-armed naga has a distinct advantage over other creatures, allowing them to attack with no fear of retaliation.

name: Genie

abilities.name: Spellcaster
abilities.description: The Genie has access to Cowardice, Create illusion, Slow, Mirth, Song of Peace and Ice Bolt. Each genie does 15.2 points of damage with Ice Bolt, and can create 15.2 hit points of illusions.

summary:
The Genie is a third-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Genies can cast the following spells: Cowardice, Create Illusion, Ice Bolt, Mirth, Slow, and Song of Peace.

name: Dragon golem

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: First strike allows this creature to strike an opponent in melee combat before it can retaliate.

abilities.name: Negate First Strike
abilities.description: Negate First strike allows this creature to counter First strike abilities or spells.

abilities.name: Mechanical
abilities.description: Mechanical creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells or abilities that only work on living creatures.

summary:
The dragon golem is a fourth-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The reflexes of a dragon golem are tuned so tightly that their lightning fast attacks strikes before even the quickest enemy. They are built and manned by the mysterious, mechanically-minded Red Dwarves.

name: Titan

abilities.name: Chaos Ward
abilities.description: Chaos Ward makes this creature 50% resistant to Chaos spells, and its Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Chaos-aligned opponents.

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Normal Melee
abilities.description: This creature's Normal Melee means it doesn't suffer the melee combat damage penalty suffered by most ranged creatures.

summary:
The titan is a fourth-level creature of the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Unlike most ranged creatures, titans do full damage to adjacent targets. They are also resistant to Chaos Magic spells and take less damage from Chaos-aligned opponents.

name: Evil sorceress

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport allows this creature to move instantly to any point on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Spellcaster
abilities.description: Spellcaster allows this creature to cast Banish, Mass cancellation, Implosion, and Mass Slow during combat.

abilities.name: Magic Mirror
abilities.description: This creature's Magic Mirror ability allows it to reflect hostile spells back upon the caster like the Magic Mirror spell.

summary:
The evil sorceress is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Academy in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: The Gathering Storm. She is found at the Ward of Sorcery.

The evil sorceress combines powerful spellcasting with a natural defense against enemy spells and the ability to teleport on the battlefield.

name: Skeleton

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Skeletal
abilities.description: Skeletal increases this creature's Ranged Defense by 100%.

summary:
The skeleton is a level-one creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

It is difficult to shoot a creature made up entirely of bone. Hence, the skeleton's improved defense against ranged attacks.

name: Imp

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Mana Leech
abilities.description: Mana Leech allows this creature to drain mana from enemy spellcasters each turn and transfer it to a nearby friendly spellcaster.

summary:
The imp is a level-one creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Imps drain spell points from enemy spellcasters and transfer them to friendly spellcasters.

name: Ghost

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifact (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Aging
abilities.description: This creature's attack has a chance of temporarily Aging the enemy. An Aged target has its Attack skill decreased by 25%, its Defense skill decreased by 20%, and its Speed and Movement decreased by 50%.

abilities.name: Insubstantial
abilities.description: Insubstantial increases this creature's Melee and Ranged Defense by 100%.

summary:
The ghost is a second-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The ethereal ghosts can drain life energy from their opponents, aging their prey in seconds. This causes any target to become slower and weaker in combat.

name: Cerberus

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: This creature's No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

abilities.name: 3-Headed Attack
abilities.description: With the 3-Headed Attack all enemies standing to the left, front and right of the creature are attacked simultaneously.

summary:
The cerberus is a second-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The three-headed cerberi can attack up to 3 adjacent enemies simultaneously. These enemies cannot retaliate against a cerberus attack.

name: Vampire

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: This creature's No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

abilities.name: Life Draining
abilities.description: This creature's Life Draining attack sucks the life force from its enemies. This life force will heal damage received in combat and even resurrect those who have died.

summary:
The vampire is a third-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Vampires regain health when they attack a living opponent. Health gained this way can even resurrect fallen vampires. Their hypnotic presence also prevents their victims from retaliating.

name: Venom spawn

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Poison
abilities.description: This creature's Poison attack damages a target and then do additional damage every turn until combat ends (as long as that target is living).

summary:
The venom spawn is a third-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The hideous, malformed venom spawn spits a deadly poison on its enemies before it consumes them.

name: Bone dragon

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Skeletal
abilities.description: Skeletal increases this creature's Ranged Defense by 100%.

abilities.name: Fear
abilities.description: Fear prevents the opponent from retaliating. Anyone struck by fear runs away a short distance.

summary:
The bone dragon is a fourth-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

When a bone dragon attacks, the sight is so fearsome most enemies flee in terror. Also, a bone dragon's skeletal body improves its defense against ranged attacks.

name: Devil

abilities.name: Teleport
abilities.description: Teleport allows this creature to move instantly to any point on the battlefield.

abilities.name: Summon Demons
abilities.description: Summon Demons allows this creature to summon Ice Demons during combat.

abilities.name: Life Ward
abilities.description: Life Ward makes this creature 50% resistant to Life spells, and its Melee and Ranged Defense is increased by 50% against Life-aligned opponents.

summary:
The devil is a fourth-level creature of the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Devils can teleport to any location during combat. They are resistant to Life Magic spells and take less damage from Life-aligned opponents. They can also summon ice demons to assist them in battle.

name: Zombie

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Toughness
abilities.description: Toughness increases this creature's hit points.

summary:
The zombie is a first-level creature, connected to the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be purchased at the Desecrated Grave external dwelling.

Zombies are remarkably hard to destroy.

name: Gargoyle

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Elemental
abilities.description: Elementals are immune to certain spells (such as Poison) that only work on normal, living creatures.

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.description: This creature's Stone Skin increases its Melee and Ranged Defense by 25%. The Stoneskin spell has no additional effect.

summary:
The gargoyle is a second-level creature, connected to the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be purchased at the parapet external dwelling.

Gargoyles have naturally stony skin, which improves their defense. They are also elemental creatures, so spells and abilities which affect living things do not affect them.

name: Mummy

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Curse
abilities.description: Curse causes this creature's normal attack to also act as the Death Magic spell Curse.

summary:
The mummy is a second-level creature, connected to the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be purchased at the Embalmer's Lab external dwelling.

Mummies automatically Curse any enemy they attack.

name: Ice demon

abilities.name: Freezing Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Freezing Attack has a chance of freezing an enemy in a block of ice for two turns.

abilities.name: Cold Attack
abilities.description: In combat, this creature's normal attack is a Cold Attack, so targets with Cold Resistance will take less damage.

abilities.name: Cold Resistance
abilities.description: Cold Resistance makes this creature immune to cold-based spells. It also takes half damage from enemies with cold-based attacks.

summary:
The ice demon is a third-level creature, connected to the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be purchased at the Ice gate external dwelling.

An ice demon attack has a chance of freezing an enemy for up to 2 turns. Ice demons are also immune to cold-based spells, and take half damage from cold-based attacks (such as those of water elementals and other ice demons).

name: Dark champion

abilities.name: Charge
abilities.description: Charge allows this creature to do more damage after it charges for a long distance before attacking.

abilities.name: Undead
abilities.description: Undead creatures are not affected by morale, or by spells and abilities that only work on living creatures. Some spells and artifacts (such as Holy Water) have special effects on Undead creatures. Undead creatures, however, give an additional -2 morale penalty to all non-Death creatures.

abilities.name: Terror
abilities.description: Terror allows this creature to cast Terror on an opponent. Enemies who are frozen by Terror cannot take any actions for one turn.

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: This creature's Regeneration ability allows it to completely heal all of its wounds at the end of each turn. Regenerates up to 50 hit points per turn.

summary:
The dark champion is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Necropolis in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: The Gathering Storm. It can be purchased at the dark knight's sanctum external dwelling.

Dark Champions are powerful, twisted undead Paladins. Those facing the charge of a Dark Campion will often flee in terror, while the few remaining to fight discover the wounds inflicted upon a Dark Champion rapidly fade away.

name: Bandit

abilities.name: Stealth
abilities.description: With Stealth, this creature is invisible at a distance on the Adventure Map to 2nd level creatures and heroes with Basic Scouting. The creature is invisible to adjacent 1st level creatures and heroes with no Scouting.

summary:
The bandit is a level 1 creature in the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Bandits are invisible to 2nd level creatures on the adventure map, and to heroes with Basic Scouting. Bandits are invisible when adjacent to 1st level creatures and heroes with no scouting.

name: Orc

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Normal Melee
abilities.description: This creature's Normal Melee means it doesn't suffer the melee combat damage penalty suffered by most ranged creatures.

abilities.name: Short Range
abilities.description: Short Range dramatically decreases the damage of this ranged creature's attack at long range.

summary:
The orc is a level-one creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

An Orc's throwing axe does much damage when thrown for a short distance as it does when used in hand-to-hand. At longer distances, the damage decreases drastically.

name: Medusa

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged abilityallows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Normal Melee
abilities.description: This creature's Normal Melee means it doesn't suffer the melee combat damage penalty suffered by most ranged creatures.

abilities.name: Unlimited Shots
abilities.description: Unlimited Shots assures that this creature never runs out of ammunition when making ranged attacks.

abilities.name: Stone Gaze
abilities.description: This creature's Stone Gaze attack has a chance (depending on the strength of the creature) of killing enemies instantly by turning them into stone. The Stone Gaze damaged is dealt even if the target blocked the normal attack.

summary:
The medusa is a second-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

A medusa's gaze has chance of transforming her opponent into stone, instantly killing them. Undead, Mechanical, and Elemental creatures are immune to this ability.

name: Minotaur

abilities.name: Block
abilities.description: Block gives this creature a chance of completely blocking any melee, ranged, or area effect attack. Even if the attack is blocked, the target will receive damage from the Stone Gaze ability.

summary:
The minotaur is a second-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Minotaurs are highly skilled with the battleaxe, giving them a chance of completely deflecting any enemy attack.

name: Nightmare

abilities.name: Terror
abilities.description: Terror allows this creature to cast Terror on an opponent. Enemies who are frozen by Terror cannot take any actions for one turn.

summary:
The nightmare is a third-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The fearsome and wild nightmares have the ability to cast Terror on an opponent, causing their enemy to lose their turn.

name: Efreet

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Fire Shield
abilities.description: Fire Shield surrounds this creature in a wall of fire, allowing it to do fire damage in addition to its normal attack to an enemy.

abilities.name: Fire Attack
abilities.description: In combat, this creature's normal attack is a Fire Attack, so targets with Fire Resistance will take less damage.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance
abilities.description: Fire Resistance makes this creature immune to fire-based spells, and to damage from breath attacks if the creature is a secondary target. The creature also takes half damage from enemies with fire-based attacks.

summary:
The efreet is a third-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Efreeti are surrounded by an aura of flame that damages any enemy who strikes them. Efreeti are also immune to fire-based spells and take half damage from fire-based attacks (such as those from fire elementals and other efreeti).

name: Hydra

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: This creature's No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

abilities.name: Multiple Attack
abilities.description: Multiple Attack allows this creature to attack all nearby enemies simultaneously.

summary:
The hydra is a fourth-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

A hydra can strike at all surrounding units at the same time, and because they strike with such blinding speed their enemies cannot retaliate.

name: Black dragon

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Immune to Magic
abilities.description: This creature is completely Immune to Magic, including spells cast by friendly troops.

abilities.name: Breath Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Breath Attack allows it to attack with a blast of fire that may also harm creatures directly behind an enemy target.

summary:
The black dragon is a fourth-level creature from the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The omnious black dragon is completely immune to magic, and can attack multiple enemies with its fiery breath.

name: Pirate

abilities.name: Bonuses at Sea
abilities.description: Bonuses at Sea makes this creature faster and allows it to do more damage when fighting on the deck of a ship. Its Melee and Ranged Defense also increases.

summary:
The pirate is a first-level creature connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the pirate's cove creature dwelling.

Pirates are at home on a swaying deck, so they move faster, do more damage, and and take less damage when fighting at sea.

name: Troglodyte

abilities.name: Immune to Visual Attacks
abilities.description: Naturally blind creatures are Immune to Visual Attacks. All abilities and spells that influence vision (like Blind and Stone Gaze) do not work on it.

summary:
The troglodyte is a level-one creature, connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the troglodyte warren creature dwelling.

Troglodytes are naturally blind, so they are unaffected by blinding spells and the stone gaze of medusas.

name: Evil eye

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Random Harmful Spells
abilities.description: This creature attacks with random Harmful Spells, casting a random Chaos Magic or Death Magic spell on its enemy.

summary:
The evil eye is a second-level creature, connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the pillar of eyes creature dwelling.

When evil eyes attack, they randomly cast a harmful spell on an enemy. The possible spells include Curse, Disrupting Ray, Slow, Sorrow, Weakness, Magic Leech, and Misfortune.

name: Troll

abilities.name: Regeneration
abilities.description: This creature's Regeneration ability allows it to completely heal all of his wounds at the end of each turn. Regenerates up to 50 hit points per turn.

summary:
The troll is a second-level creature, connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the troll cave creature dwelling.

Trolls have an amazing constitution which allows them to regenerate all of their hit points at the start of each combat round.

name: Goblin knight

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: This creature's Magic Resistance gives it a chance of resisting most hostile spells. The creature also takes less damage from spells that cause direct damage.

abilities.name: Stone Skin
abilities.description: This creature's Stone Skin increases its Melee and Ranged Defense by 25%. The Stoneskin spell has no additional effect.

abilities.name: Negate First Strike
abilities.description: Negate First Strike allows this creature to counter First Strike abilities or spells.

summary:
The goblin knight is a third-level creature, connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: The Gathering Storm. It can be found at the goblin armory creature dwelling.

The heavy armor of the goblin knight grants a resistance to both magic and physical attacks, but allows enough freedom of movement for the goblin's natural quickness to overcome the fastest of opponents.

name: Megadragon

abilities.name: Breath Attack
abilities.description: This creature's arc-shaped Breath Attack allows it to attack with a blast of fire that may also harm creatures behind an enemy target.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: This creature's Magic Resistance gives it a chance of resisting most hostile spells. The creature also takes less damage from spells that cause direct damage.

summary:
The megadragon is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Asylum town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Winds of War. This creature cannot be purchased.

Quite simply, there is no creature alive or dead that could stand alone against the raw, awesome power of the Megadragon. Their extreme rarity and limited suceptibility to magic are their only known weaknesses.

name: Wolf

abilities.name: Two Attacks
abilities.description: Two Attacks allows this creature to attack twice in melee combat. The second attack occurs after the enemy's retaliation.

summary:
The wolf is a level-one creature in the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Wolves snap and claw at their opponents, getting two attacks in combat.

name: Sprite

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: This creature's No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

summary:
The sprite is a level-one creature available for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Due to a sprite's small stature and stunning speed opponents find it impossible to retaliate against their attacks.

name: White tiger

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: First Strike allows this creature to strike an opponent in melee combat before it can retaliate.

summary:
The white tiger is a second-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The wise white tiger is not only fast but a strategic genius in battle, so they can attack an enemy before they can retaliate.

name: Elf

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless she has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Shoots Twice
abilities.description: Shoots Twice allows this ranged creature to fire twice each time it attacks. The second attack occurs after any enemy retaliation.

abilities.name: Ranged First Strike
abilities.description: Ranged First Strike allows this creature to strike a target in ranged combat before its target can retaliate.

summary:
The elf is a second-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Elves, masters of the longbow, are able to attack twice per round, and their first attack always occurs before their enemy can retaliate.

name: Griffin

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Unlimited Retaliation
abilities.description: Unlimited Retaliation allows this creature to retaliate against any number of attacks in a single turn.

summary:
The griffin is a third-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Griffins are fierce, tireless fighters who have an unlimited capacity to retaliate against enemy attacks.

name: Unicorn

abilities.name: Blind
abilities.description: This creature's attack has a chance of Blinding an enemy.

summary:
The unicorn is a third-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The touch of a unicorn's magical horn has a chance of blinding its opponent.

name: Phoenix

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Rebirth
abilities.description: This creature can use the Rebirth ability to return to life after it is killed in combat. If all are killed before they have used this ability, a portion will automatically be reborn.

abilities.name: Breath Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Breath Attack allows it to attack with a blast of fire that may also harm creatures directly behind an enemy target.

abilities.name: Fire Resistance
abilities.description: Fire Resistance makes this creature immune to fire-based spells, and to damage from breath attacks if the creature is a secondary target. The creature also takes half damage from enemies with fire-based attacks.

summary:
The phoenix is a fourth-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The fiery breath of the phoenix can attack multiple enemies under the right conditions, and once per combat, it can attempt to return from the dead.

name: Faerie dragon

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Spellcaster
abilities.description: Spellcaster allows this creature to use a variety of spells during combat.

abilities.name: Magic Mirror
abilities.description: This creature's Magic Mirror ability allows it to reflect hostile spells back upon the caster like the Magic Mirror spell.

summary:
The faerie dragon is a fourth-level creature for the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Faerie dragon have a natural defense against magical attacks, reflecting spells back on the caster (similar to the Magic Mirror spell).

name: Leprechaun

abilities.name: Fortune
abilities.description: Fortune allows this creature to cast the Nature Magic spell Fortune.

summary:
The leprechaun is a first-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Magic Rainbow external dwelling.

Leprechauns can boost the luck of friendly targets.

name: Satyr

abilities.name: Mirth
abilities.description: Mirth allows this creature to cast the Life Magic spell Mirth.

summary:
The satyr is a second-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Wine Keg external dwelling.

The cheerful, optimistic satyr can cast the Mirth spell, raising the morale of friendly targets.

name: Air elemental

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Elemental
abilities.description: Elementals are immune to certain spells (such as Poison) that only work on normal, living creatures.

abilities.name: Insubstantial
abilities.description: Insubstantial increases this creature's Melee and Ranged Defense by 100%.

summary:
The air elemental is a third-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Air Portal external dwelling.

Air elementals are made up of nothing more than swirling air, so it is much more difficult to hit them with physical attacks.

name: Water elemental

abilities.name: Elemental
abilities.description: Elementals are immune to certain spells (such as Poison) that only work on normal, living creatures.

abilities.name: Spellcaster
abilities.description: Spellcaster allows this creature to cast Fatigue, Ice bolt, Quicksand, and Weakness during combat.

abilities.name: Cold Attack
abilities.description: In combat, this creature's normal attack is a Cold Attack, so targets with Cold Resistance will take less damage.

abilities.name: Cold Resistance
abilities.description: Cold Resistance makes this creature immune to cold-based spells. It also takes half damage from enemies with cold-based attacks.

summary:
The water elemental is a third-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Water Portal external dwelling.

Water elementals are immune to cold-based spells and take half damage from cold-based attacks (such as those from ice demons or other water elementals).

name: Fire elemental

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Elemental

abilities.description: In combat, this creature's normal attack is a Fire Attack, so targets with Fire Resistance will take less damage.

abilities.description: Fire Resistance makes this creature immune to fire-based spells, and to damage from breath attacks if the creature is a secondary target. The creature also takes half damage from enemies with fire-based attacks.

summary:
The fire elemental is a third-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Fire Portal external dwelling.

Fire elementals are immune to fire-based spells and take half damage from fire-based attacks (such as those from efreeti and other fire elementals).

name: Earth elemental

abilities.name: Elemental
abilities.description: Elementals are immune to certain spells (such as Poison) that only work on normal, living creatures.

abilities.name: Magic Resistance
abilities.description: This creature's Magic Resistance gives it a chance of resisting most hostile spells. The creature also takes less damage from spells that cause direct damage.

summary:
The earth elemental is a third-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Earth Portal external dwelling.

Earth elementals have a 50% chance of resisting any hostile spell, and take only half damage from spell attacks.

name: Waspwort

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Weakness
abilities.description: Weakness causes this creature's attack to cast the Weakness spell on its target. Weakened creatures do less damage in combat.

summary:
The waspwort is a third-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Hothouse external dwelling.

Waspworts are semi-intelligent, carnivorous plants. They are capable of hurling toxic needles at their prey, causing Weakness in anyone they strike.

name: Mantis

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: First Strike allows this creature to strike an opponent in melee combat before it can retaliate.

abilities.name: Binding
abilities.description: Binding allows the creature to Bind the last creature it attacks with its forelimbs. Bound enemies cannot move, though they can still attack, retaliate and cast spells. Bound creatures do half damage when they attack. If the attacking creature moves, the Binding is also removed.

summary:
The mantis is a fourth-level creature of the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It can be found at the Creature Portal, or the Mantis Nest external dwelling.

The mantis is extremely fast for a creature of its size, giving it the ability to attack an enemy before they can retaliate. It can also bind an enemy by grabbing them with a foreleg.

name: Gargantuan

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Shoots Twice
abilities.description: Shoots Twice allows this ranged creature to fire twice each time it attacks. The second attack occurs after any enemy retaliation.

abilities.name: Area Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Area Attack allows its ranged attacks to strike all targets, friendly or hostile, in a small area (3x3 yards).

abilities.name: Normal Melee
abilities.description: This creature's Normal Melee means it doesn't suffer the melee combat damage penalty suffered by most ranged creatures.

summary:
The gargantuan is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Preserve town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: The Gathering Storm. It can be found at the Gargantuan Dell external dwelling.

A large earth elemental, resembling a Behemoth, the Gargantuan attacks with the very earth in a devastating barrage of rocks. In melee, the Gargantuan pounds its opponents with its massive fists.

name: Berserker

abilities.name: Two Attacks
abilities.description: Two Attacks allows this creature to attack twice in melee combat. The second attack occurs after the enemy's retaliation.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: A Berserk creature must attack or move to attack every turn. They cannot wait. They are also immune to all forms of fear.

summary:
The berserker is a first-level Stronghold creature in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Berserkers attack in a frenzy with no thought of defense. They are so riled up, in fact, that they cannot be controlled during combat. At the earliest opportunity, they will charge the enemy.

name: Centaur

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Normal Melee
abilities.description: This creature's Normal Melee means it doesn't suffer the melee combat damage penalty suffered by most ranged creatures.

abilities.name: Short Range
abilities.description: Short Range dramatically decreases the damage of this ranged creature's attack at long range.

summary:
The centaur is a level-one creature from the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Centaurs use spears in combat. The damage done by a thrown spear decreases rapidly with distance, but unlike other ranged creatures, the centaur suffers no penalty in melee combat.

name: Harpy

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: No Retaliation
abilities.description: No Retaliation ability allows it to attack without any chance of retaliation.

abilities.name: Strike and Return
abilities.description: Strike and Return allows this creature to fly back to its starting point after attacking.

summary:
The harpy is one of the second level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Harpies can fly up to an enemy, attack and return to their starting position before the enemy has the opportunity to retaliate.

name: Nomad

abilities.name: First Strike
abilities.description: First Strike allows this creature to strike an opponent in melee combat before it can retaliate.

summary:
The nomad is one of the second level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Nomads have mastered the art of swift combat, striking before their enemy gets the opportunity to retaliate.

name: Ogre mage

abilities.name: Bloodlust
abilities.description: This creature can cast the Chaos Magic spell Bloodlust.

summary:
The ogre mage is one of the third-level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Ogre magi have the innate ability to cast the Bloodlust spell, goading others into a dangerous battle rage.

name: Cyclops

abilities.name: Ranged
abilities.description: The Ranged ability allows this creature to attack enemies at a distance, but in melee combat this creature does half damage unless it has the Normal Melee ability.

abilities.name: Area Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Area Attack allows its ranged attacks to strike all targets, friendly or hostile, in a small area (3x3 yards).

summary:
The cyclops is one of the third-level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The cyclops hurls huge boulders that shatter on impact, damaging all nearby targets.

name: Thunderbird

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Flying allows this creature to fly over obstacles, creatures, heroes, and castle walls.

abilities.name: Lightning Attack
abilities.description: This creature's Lightning Attack summons a bolt of lightning that strikes its opponent immediately after its normal attack.

summary:
The thunderbird is one of the fourth-level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

Thunderbirds can summon lightning to strike enemies they have just attacked.

name: Behemoth

abilities.name: Strength
abilities.description: Strength increases the creature's combat damage.

summary:
The behemoth is one of the fourth-level creatures available in the Stronghold town in Heroes of Might and Magic IV.

The deadly, lumbering behemoth is so powerful that few can match its strength in battle.

name: Mermaid

abilities.name: Hypnotize
abilities.description: In addition to this creature's normal attack, its Hypnotize ability has a chance of taking control of an enemy opponent for one turn.

summary:
The mermaid is a second-level creature, connected to the Stronghold in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It cannot be acquired in-game, only added in the Scenario Editor.

Mermaids have a chance of hypnotizing their opponents, giving them control of their target for one turn. They are also immune to the Charm and Diplomacy skills.

name: Sea monster

abilities.name: Devouring
abilities.description: This creature's Devouring ability gives it a chance of swallowing an enemy whole when it attacks.

summary:
The sea monster is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Stronghold in Heroes of Might and Magic IV. It cannot be aquired in-game, only added in the Scenario Editor.

Beware these legendary creatures of the deep! Sea monsters have a chance of devouring any opponent they attack. They are also immune to the Charm and Diplomacy skills.

name: Frenzied gnasher

abilities.name: Immune to Magic
abilities.description: This creature is completely Immune to Magic, including spells cast by friendly troops.

abilities.name: Berserk
abilities.description: A Berserk creature must attack or move to attack every turn. They cannot wait. They are also immune to all forms of fear.

summary:
The frenzied gnasher is a fourth-level creature, connected to the Stronghold in Heroes of Might and Magic IV: Winds of War. It can be purchased at the beast pen.

The Frenzied Gnasher is a massive and powerful beast that is immune to magic. A few have been captured and trained just enough to be useful in battle, but turned loose there is no stopping it.
